acceptedUnresolved.reason: worldspawn music key of maps/oa_dm1.bsp. The extension is written out, so S_CodecGetSound uses the ogg codec first and, when that fails, strips the extension and retries the remaining codecs as 'music/sonic6.wav' and 'music/sonic6.opus' (ioq3 code/client/snd_codec.c); no pinned OpenArena release ships any of the three. slimefac names the same stem without an extension and reaches the same absence, so the set accepts two spellings of one missing track; a missing track is silence, not a failure

q3map2's placeholder for a face the compiler could not texture, written into the shader lump of maps/oa_dm1.bsp; no OpenArena release ships an image for it. The closure walks the whole lump, which is the conservative reading, and the engine does not: R_LoadShaders only byte-swaps the flags, so a shader-lump entry reaches R_FindShader through ShaderForShaderNum alone, once per surface (ioq3 code/renderergl2/tr_bsp.c), and none of this BSP's 902 surfaces references the entry. Two other lumps can register a shader name independently of the shader lump, and neither names this one: a fog record carries its own shader string and R_LoadFogs registers that (its one fog volume names 'textures/liquids/lavahell'), and R_LoadEntities registers 'remapshader' and 'vertexremapshader' worldspawn values through R_RemapShader, which this BSP has none of. So R_FindShader never runs for it, nothing renders through it, and the engine reports nothing - not even at PRINT_DEVELOPER
